ic_name: DALI (Digital Addressable Lighting Interface, IEC 62386 via TI SLAA422A)
test_cases_present: partial - SLAA422A provides reference firmware and demonstrates a working DALI control gear on the TPS62260LED-338 EVM, but does not publish a formal IEC 62386-102 conformance testbench. The test cases below are derived from the protocol description (Section 1 of SLAA422A), the supported command set (Tables 3-5), the unsupported set (Table 4), and the per-state-figure of the gear's transaction loop.
derived_compliance_test_categories: Reset behavior: enable bit cleared; transmit-empty flag set; receive-flag cleared after reset.
Master mode transmission: write to data register + clock-cycle delay + N edges + receive-flag set.
Slave mode transmission: select line goes LOW + N edges from master + receive-flag set after last edge.
